e7_s4_rationale: The presence of a rapidly growing, amelanotic, and pedunculated mass with an ulcerated surface, along with positive reactivity to melanocytic markers HMB45, MITF2, and Melan-A, and a high proliferative index as shown by Ki-67, strongly supports the diagnosis of malignant melanoma of the caruncle.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Squamous cell carcinoma
e7_s4_rejected.why: Lack of evidence supporting squamous cell carcinoma, such as specific histological features or immunohistochemical markers.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Sebaceous gland carcinoma
e7_s4_rejected.why: No indication of sebaceous gland origin or specific markers for sebaceous gland carcinoma.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Mucosal melanoma
e7_s4_rejected.why: The lesion arises from the caruncle, not mucosal tissue, and lacks specific features of mucosal melanoma.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Nodular melanoma
e7_s4_rejected.why: While the tumor is melanocytic in origin, the specific characteristics and location (caruncle) better fit malignant melanoma of the caruncle.
